label: sec:lepton-meson-parallel-intro
html: The torus-knot family T(2,k) and the amphichiral figure-eight knot 4_1 bridge the purely algebraic Hecke quotient of this chapter to the geometric and particle structures of the chapters that follow. Through the Frobenius pairing and Hoefsmit's seminormal representation on H_3(q), the same two-strand and three-strand braid operators that classify leptons also govern meson binding amplitudes, cusp-torus bar parity, and the strong–electromagnetic decomposition of the kaon-to-pion mass ratio.
